notes.title: Version v2.01 released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]With these four new game modes, the game has evolved into a racing and sports/dexterity game:
[*]-GUIDED BALL
[*]-POWER PUNCH
[*]-CLIMBING MANIA
[*]-SCRAMBLE ACTION
[*]The graphics have been adapted so that their spatial effect is more impressive in VR
[*]More intense gameplay
[*]Optimised for Meta Rift or Quest 2 via Airlink
[/list]

notes.title: Version v1.102 released.
notes.content:
[b]New game mode - Pursuit race[/b] 
[list]
[*]Cockpit view.
[*]5 additional race tracks.
[*]Adapted gameplay.
[*]You can steer your car intuitively with the VR haeadset. This feature can be activated in the menu.
[/list]	
[b]Gamemode Hub[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now select 3 gamemodes from a menu.
[*] Full Campaign.
[*] Single Slot Race.
[*] Single Pursuit Race.
[/list]
[b]Various[/b]
[list]
[*] Color scheme is now a compromise for Oculus Rift and Quest 2 (Air Link) users.
[*] New menu structure.
[*] New game options: standing or rolling start. Pure or mixed full campaign.
[*] Music source is tied to the car in slot race mode.
[*] Performance and handling improvements, bug fixes.
[/list]
